title: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - AIMS Institutes
content: AIMS School of Business offers a 2-year full-time MBA program with an industry-focused curriculum. The program boasts exceptional placement records with a highest package of 23 LPA and an average package of 8 LPA. Eligibility: Applicants must have a graduate degree under 10+2+3 or 10+2+4 pattern from a recognized university with at least 50% aggregate marks. Selection Process: Involves entrance test scores (MAT, CAT, CMAT, XAT, KMAT, or PGCET) followed by group discussions and personal interviews. Application Deadline: The last date to apply for the current admission cycle is April 30, 2026. Financial support and scholarships are available for meritorious students.

title: Placement Cell | AIMS Institutes Bangalore
content: AIMS Institutes has established a strong reputation for placements across various sectors. The placement cell provides end-to-end support, including resume building, skill enhancement workshops, and mock interviews. Recent placement highlights include: 100% placement for BHM (Hotel Management) and MSW (Social Work) students. MBA placement rate stands at 84% with top recruiters like Deloitte, Amazon, EY, KPMG, Oracle, Accenture, Federal Bank, Tech Mahindra, and ICICI Bank. The corporate relations team actively collaborates with over 100+ recruitment partners to ensure diverse career opportunities for graduates.

title: Admission Procedure and Guidelines 2026
content: The admission process at AIMS Institutes is designed to identify talented and motivated students. Steps: 1. Apply Online: Visit apply.theaims.ac.in and fill out the enquiry form. 2. Screening: Assessment of academic records and entrance scores. 3. Interview: Selected candidates are called for a personal interview. 4. Selection: Final offer based on overall performance. For 2026, the application deadline is April 30, 2026. Required documents include 10th/12th mark sheets, graduation degree certificate (for PG), and entrance exam scorecards.

title: Hostel and Residential Facilities | AIMS Campus
content: AIMS provides comfortable and secure residential facilities for its students. There are 4 dedicated hostels (2 for boys and 2 for girls) located within or near the campus. Facilities include: High-speed Wi-Fi, 24/7 security with CCTV surveillance, well-furnished rooms (single/double occupancy options), dedicated study areas, and in-house dining serving nutritious meals. The hostel administration ensures a safe and conducive environment for academic success and personal growth.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Admissions & Life at AIMS
content: Q: Is AIMS accredited? A: Yes, AIMS is NAAC 'A' grade accredited and has various international accreditations like IACBE. Q: What is the medium of instruction? A: English is the primary medium of instruction for all programs. Q: Are international students eligible? A: Yes, international students are welcome to apply; they must meet the eligibility criteria and provide appropriate equivalence certificates. Q: Are scholarships available? A: Yes, merit-based and category-specific scholarships are offered. Q: How do I contact admissions? A: You can visit the campus or use the enquiry form on the website.

title: Programs Offered | AIMS Institutes
content: AIMS Institutes offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs. Key programs include: Master of Business Administration (MBA), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) with specializations in Aviation Management and Business Analytics, Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM), Master of Social Work (MSW), and various Commerce and IT programs. All programs are recognized by UGC and relevant professional bodies, ensuring high career relevance and academic rigor.
